note: A CAMPAIGN RETROSPECTIVE CAN GO STALE DURING ITS OWN FINAL HOURS, and the close-out audit that catches it is worth its cost. The Latch merged clean, then a what-did-NOT-survive pass over the git-ignored scratch found three committed DoD records already false: the retrospective headline said twelve defects when the ledger reached fourteen, its section heading said Two gates while its own body listed three, and the Confidence Gradient chapter still said twelve and omitted the campaign most severe bug entirely. Cause: the final whole-branch review found a fourteenth defect AFTER the DoD artifacts were written, the fix wave updated one section, and nobody revised the headline. That is a record outliving its subject, which is the exact failure the retrospective itself documents, reproduced one level up in its own arithmetic. Correction submitted as req-dd53f2f7ab4e-20260828T185501Z. THE TRANSFERABLE PART, TWO THINGS. First: ask a reviewer what did NOT survive, as its own question, against the scratch rather than the diff. A diff review cannot find an absence. It checked about forty items and found six with no committed home, and the top one was a real decision 0013 violation. Second, and sharper, a finding that got STRONGER when checked: the scratch said three new tests sit outside the commit gate until a green chamber run rewrites the roster. The merge WAS that run. It rewrote subfloor-roster.tsv and added three integration tests and NONE of the behavioural ones, because they cost 13.4s, 17.1s and 13.3s against BASELINE_FLOOR_SECS = 1.0. The exclusion is PERMANENT AND BY DESIGN, not a temporary gap, and the predecessor warm_is_refused_while_asleep is out for the same reason. Verified by count in main: zero roster entries for either behavioural test, one for every_bare_verb_help_lists_is_classified. So gate-commit RUNS the agreement check that has a documented blind zone and runs NO test that can see into it.
